summary: Completed testing of DrON Topografía export functionality. All 5 requested features verified working correctly - Excel and PDF export buttons in Métricas Históricas view, and both backend endpoints returning valid files with project data.
critical_code_review_comments: Export endpoints properly implemented with correct content types and Content-Disposition headers
Excel export generates 3 sheets: Resumen General, Avances Semanales, Comparaciones Residente
PDF export includes executive summary with KPIs and project data tables
Frontend buttons have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Export functions handle empty data gracefully
context_for_next_testing_agent: Export functionality fully tested. GET /api/exportar/metricas-excel returns valid .xlsx (8547 bytes), GET /api/exportar/metricas-pdf returns valid .pdf (4246 bytes). Both buttons in MetricasHistoricasView.jsx work correctly.

excel_button_in_metricas_view.details: Green 'Excel' button visible in Métricas Históricas header with data-testid='export-excel-btn', clickable and triggers download

pdf_button_in_metricas_view.details: Red 'PDF' button visible in Métricas Históricas header with data-testid='export-pdf-btn', clickable and triggers download

excel_endpoint_returns_valid_xlsx.details: GET /api/exportar/metricas-excel returns 200, content-type: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, valid PK header (ZIP/XLSX format), 8547 bytes

pdf_endpoint_returns_valid_pdf.details: GET /api/exportar/metricas-pdf returns 200, content-type: application/pdf, valid %PDF header, 4246 bytes

exported_files_contain_project_data.details: Both files contain project data - Excel has 3 sheets with project metrics, PDF has executive summary with KPIs (6 proyectos, 31,000 m³ excavación, 148 pilas, 200 anclas, 23 muros)
